COMMERCE [조직 ​소개] 저희 ​조직은 무신사 ​커머스 운영 ​전반에서 ​발생하는 다양한 비즈니스 ​문제를 정의하고, ​운영 구조·정책·시스템 개선을 통해 현업의 비효율을 현실적으로 해결하는 역할을 수행합니다. 저희는 단순한 현상 유지나 반복적인 현업 지원에 머무르지 않습니다. 상품, 주문, 재고, 발주 등 커머스 코어 도메인의 구조적 병목을 진단하여 시스템 개선과 운영 안정화를 이끌어내며 기존 비즈니스를 고도화하는 일에 깊게 관여합니다. 동시에 무신사가 새롭게 확장하는 신규 비즈니스와 운영 모델이 실제 작동 가능한 형태로 안착될 수 있도록 End-to-End로 프로세스를 설계합니다. [담당 업무] 새로운 판매 형태나 비즈니스 모델이 시스템적으로 구현 가능한지 검토하고, 실제 구동할 수 있는 운영 구조와 데이터 흐름을 설계합니다. 개발, MD, 물류 등 다양한 유관 부서의 요구사항을 수집하여 싱크를 맞추고, 프로젝트 전반을 리드합니다. 프로젝트 오픈 단계부터 현업 담당자가 안정적으로 운영할 수 있을 때까지 초기 안착 과정을 현장에서 서포트하고 지속적으로 Follow-up합니다. 상품 등록, 주문, 재고, 물류 관리 등 커머스 전반의 비효율과 구조적 병목을 진단하여 실질적인 고도화 방안을 수립합니다. 비즈니스 변화에 따른 기존 가이드라인의 한계를 보완하고, 현장 혼선을 줄이기 위한 운영 프로세스 재정비 및 매뉴얼화를 수행합니다. 커머스 시스템의 리스크 요인을 파악하고 안정적인 시스템 운영을 위해 개선 과제를 관리합니다. [자격 요건] 이커머스 또는 리테일 플랫폼 분야에서 7년 이상의 PM/서비스 기획 경력을 보유하신 분 상품 구조 정의, 주문 마이크로 서비스 등 커머스 코어 도메인을 End-to-End로 설계하고 고도화해 보신 분 캠페인, 브랜드 정책, 물류(WMS/SCM) 등이 결합된 복잡한 비즈니스 구조를 분석하고 시스템화해 보신 분 가이드가 없는 환경에서 제약사항을 주도적으로 수집하여, 실행 가능한 단계별 운영 프로세스를 구축해 보신 분 비즈니스 비효율 발견부터 개발 요구사항(PRD) 도출, 시스템 배포 및 안정화까지 프로젝트 전 과정을 리드해 보신 분 사업 부서의 요구사항을 고려하여, 비즈니스 우선순위를 명확히 판단할 수 있으신 분 거시적인 운영 임팩트를 고려하는 동시에, 예외 케이스(Edge Case)를 고려한 실무 디테일 설계가 가능하신 분 [우대 사항] 패션 버티컬 플랫폼에서 특유의 상품 속성(옵션, 시즌 등), 정산, 물류 특성을 깊이 있게 경험해 보신 분 급격하게 성장하는 대규모 트래픽 및 거래액(GMV) 환경에서 커머스 플랫폼 구조 개편을 경험해 보신 분 다수의 서드파티(3rd Party) 솔루션 연동 또는 이종 산업 간의 대형 제휴 프로젝트를 메인 리드해 보신 분 대규모 조직 내에서 프레임워크나 가이드라인을 수립하여 전사적인 프로젝트 관리(PMO) 체계를 이끌어보신 분 기술적 백그라운드가 있어 테크 조직과 아키텍처 수준의 논의가 가능하신 분 [지원 서류] 이력서(필수) / 포트폴리오(선택) (참고) 이력서/포트폴리오 작성 팁 이력서/포트폴리오에는 왜 해당 문제를 해결해야 했는지, 어떤 전략을 세웠는지, 어떤 성과가 있었는지 등에 대한 문제 정의, 문제 해결, 성과에 대한 전반적인 내용을 담아주세요. 프로젝트의 성공과 실패를 떠나, 1차 면접에서 인터뷰어와 심도있는 이야기를 나눌 수 있도록 프로젝트의 이해도가 높은 이력서로 구성해주세요. (프로젝트별 기여도 표시) [근무 조건] 정규직 [전형 절차] 접수 기간 : 상시지원 전형 절차 : 서류 전형 - 1차 인터뷰 - 2차 인터뷰 - 처우 협의 - 최종합격 * 전형 절차는 포지션 별 상이하게 운영될 수 있습니다. 문의사항 : [email protected] [기타 사항] 본 포지션은 수시 진행으로 우수 인재 채용 시 마감될 수 있습니다. 적합한 지원자에게 채용 담당자가 개별 연락 예정이며, 내부 규정에 따라 각 전형 단계별 개별 피드백은 제공하지 않습니다. 최종 합격자는 3개월간의 수습기간이 적용되며, 해당 기간 중 급여는 100% 지급됩니다. 입사지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

review_candidates.title: Program Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Company Description Lakarmissionen International is a humanitarian organization focused on improving the well-being of vulnerable communities through health, education, and social development initiatives. The organization collaborates with local partners to design and implement sustainable programs that address community needs. It emphasizes accountability, transparency, and ethical practices in all operations. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, uphold high professional standards, and support inclusive development that respects local cultures and contexts. Role Description The Program Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based in Moyale, responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Lakarmissionen International’s programs in the area. The role includes coordinating day-to-day program activities, maintaining schedules and work plans, and ensuring that projects are executed according to organizational standards and donor requirements. The Program Coordinator will facilitate communication between local stakeholders, partners, and internal teams, prepare reports and documentation, and assist with data collection and basic analysis. This role also involves responding to community inquiries, supporting outreach activities, organizing meetings and trainings, and proactively identifying challenges and opportunities to improve program delivery. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Program Management and Program Development skills to support planning, implementation, and improvement of community-focused initiatives. Candidates should possess solid Project Management skills, including organizing tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring timely delivery of project activities. Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage respectfully with community members, partners, and colleagues. Relevant experience in humanitarian, development, or community-based programs in similar contexts is highly beneficial. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Proficiency in basic computer applications (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, email) and comfort with digital reporting tools. Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural setting and maintain high ethical and professional standards. A diploma or degree in social sciences, development studies, management, or a related field is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Product Manager - Clinical Terminology Platform
review_candidates.description: A Product Manager, Terminology Platform helps define and execute the product strategy for IMO’s foundational terminology platform, including the Knowledge Graph, Reference Data Sets, external content partnerships, and the broader platform capabilities. You will translate market needs, customer commitments, clinical knowledge strategy, and operational priorities into clear roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes. This role requires the ability to connect clinical terminology expertise with product strategy, partner closely across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Legal, Growth, and Customer teams, and drive work that improves content expansion, interoperability, AI-enablement, and customer value. What You’ll Do Drive product strategy and roadmap execution for the Terminology Platform, including the Knowledge Graph, content expansion, Reference Data Sets, and related foundational terminology capabilities. Partner with Product leadership to shape the broader terminology platform vision, including migration toward a scalable, graph-based knowledge management model that supports Provider, Health Tech, Payer, and Life Sciences use cases. Own and prioritize content expansion roadmaps, including lab strategy, continuous delivery, and commercialization readiness for high-impact clinical domains. Translate customer, market, and internal stakeholder needs into clear business cases, product requirements, and user stories that guide cross-functional teams. Help advance Knowledge Acceleration goals by improving content creation velocity, quality measurement, human-in-the-loop review models, and AI-assisted terminology workflows. Coordinate external content and vendor strategy, including source prioritization, licensing readiness, vendor relationship management, ingestion planning, and alignment to market needs. Collaborate with Legal, Clinical Informatics, Mapping, Engineering, Architecture, Growth, Support, and Customer teams to resolve dependencies, manage trade-offs, and keep complex initiatives moving forward. Use data, customer feedback, and coverage/quality signals to identify terminology gaps, prioritize investments, and demonstrate business and customer impact. Support commercialization and go-to-market readiness by articulating product positioning, customer value, release impacts, and sales enablement needs for terminology platform capabilities. Guide cross-functional teams through the product lifecycle amid ambiguity, evolving priorities, regulatory/licensing constraints, and competing business needs. What You’ll Need 5+ years of experience working with clinical terminology, healthcare data, product development, product management, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Clinical Informatics. Strong healthcare domain knowledge, with experience in clinical terminology, coding systems, interoperability standards, or structured healthcare data. Working knowledge of major clinical code systems and vocabularies, such as CPT, LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, HCPCS, CDT, DSM, or related content sources. Ability to translate complex customer, clinical, technical, or business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes. Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Engineering, Clinical Informatics, Mapping, Data Science, Legal, Sales, Growth, Support, or Customer Success. Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance near-term execution, long-term platform strategy, customer commitments, business impact, and operational feasibility. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex clinical, technical, and product concepts clearly to executive, technical, clinical, and commercial audiences. Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site team collaboration. Preferred Skills Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontology models, graph-based data structures, AI-assisted workflows, APIs, or terminology platform architecture. Experience with third-party content, licensing, vendor management, reference data sets, crosswalks, or content ingestion workflows. $115,000 - $145,000 a year Compensation at IMO Health is determined by job level, role requirements, and each candidate’s experience, skills, and location. The listed base pay represents the target for new hires with individual compensation varying accordingly. These figures exclude potential bonuses, equity, or sales incentives, which may also be part of the total compensation package. Our recruiter will provide additional details during the hiring process. IMO Health also offers a comprehensive benefits package. To learn more, please visit IMO Health's Careers Page . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Supply Chain Team Mission: To have the right product, in the right quantity, at the right place, at the best price and payment terms. Never out of stock, never overstocked. What We’re Looking For: • Owner mindset – You own your strategy, execution, and results • Relentless – You never stop until every challenge is solved • Fast & proactive – You move quickly, anticipate, and act • Great negotiator – Speaking excellent English, you build strong relationships and secure the best outcomes • Adaptable – You thrive in change and grow with it • Collaborative – You align with others and drive progress together Requirements: 2+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supplier management (preferably in consumer goods, supplements, or manufacturing) Fluent in English (written and spoken) Strong command of Google Sheets and equivalent tools for managing and analyzing procurement data Based in or near the CET time zone Why Join Us: ● A full-time 100% remote job ● Competitive performance-based bonus ● Work in the Central European Time Zone with flexibility of working hours ● Anniversary and birthday bonuses ● 30 paid days off per year ● Parental leave ● Unlimited supply of Vimerson Health supplements ● Charity Match Programme: The company will match any donations that you personally make to your charity of choice ● Regular team-building activities ● Possibilities for personal and professional growth ● Compensation: €40,000–€45,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience and qualifications. We’re growing FAST. There’s a lot of opportunity here — for those who bring their A-game and take full ownership of their role. We offer more than a job: we offer full ownership of a critical role in a fast-growth, fast-paced company with an entrepreneurial mindset. review_candidates.title: Precision Assembler
review_candidates.description: Company Overview: If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone! Role Summary: The Precision Assembler will be responsible for the preparation of assembly work and documentation. This position will also assemble a variety of equipment and tools and perform test requirements. Additionally, the Precision Assembler will be responsible for the disassembly, cleaning, inspecting and reassembly during any repair process. This person will have access to the most modern materials and tools at our facility to accomplish these expectations to ensure the delivery of a high-quality product to our customers. Responsibilities & Requirements: Complete assemblies according to drawings, instructions, and work orders, performing testing when required. Demonstrates an advanced understanding of inspection equipment, their functions and uses to ensure that all parts and assemblies are within specifications. Ensure all parts and components are clean prior to assembly and that assemblies are completed properly, following all assembly procedures. Follow all safety procedures, and wear required personal safety equipment. Operate various precision measuring tools, i.e. micrometers, vernier, and CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machines), in a warehouse environment, as well as hand tools, i.e. hydraulic torque wrench and fire torch. Troubleshoot and resolve issues within assembly. Have a sharp eye for detail and a results-oriented approach. Capable of calculating basic mathematical functions including computation of rate, ratio, and percent and to convert one type of measurement into another. Participate in CIP activities as needed and comply with all Flowserve policies and procedures. Ability to read and interpret documents such as blueprints and technical drawings safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and communicate clearly to peers, supervisors, and customers Show a customer-service mindset for on-time delivery and quality workmanship. Basic computer aptitude to use/learn data entry systems and to use Microsoft Office Package. Demonstrate behavior that promotes team building and continuous improvement. Must be able to stand for long periods of time able to safely lift, up to, 50 lbs. Other duties as assigned. Preferred Experience / Skills: Workshop experience. Knowledge of automation control and electrical components. Experience as a mechanic for rotating machines, mechanical devices or as a general mechanic. General certificate of education or vocational training. HS Diploma / GED and 3-5 years relevant experience Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve. Req ID : R-21337 Job Family Group : Operations Job Family : OP Precision Assembly EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowservecareers.com as result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to employment@flowserve.com.
